useWhen: Inspect resident business bot state, assignments and activity receipts while keeping lifecycle and spend changes owner-scoped.
avoidWhen: Launching, resuming, funding or allocating a bot from catalog metadata alone

inputs.scope: caller-selected owner artifacts and bounded task

outputs.receipt: actual observations, native status and unresolved stages

authority.binding: caller-authorized target scope and owner-reviewed effective runtime policy

compatibilityNote: Hermes storage format only; client installation, target runtime and live behavior are not qualified. Bind current owner commands and permissions separately.
